cases.case: a link to /about from the home page
warnings: index.html links to /about, which leaves the app's path address. Write about instead.

cases.case: a link to /about from a page under pages/
warnings: pages/menu.html links to /about, which leaves the app's path address. Write about instead.

cases.case: a link to /about from a page two folders down
warnings: pages/guide/install.html links to /about, which leaves the app's path address. Write ../about instead.

cases.case: an image at /img.png
warnings: index.html loads /img.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write img.png instead.

cases.case: a form posting to /send
warnings: index.html submits to /send, which leaves the app's path address. Write send instead.

cases.case: a root-relative link to the home URL
warnings: index.html links to /, which leaves the app's path address. Write ./index.html instead.

cases.case: a root-relative query string on the home URL
warnings: index.html links to /?q=1, which leaves the app's path address. Write ./?q=1 instead.

cases.case: a path under /_littlebox is not prefixed by the app
warnings: index.html links to /_littlebox/files/x, which leaves the app's path address. Write _littlebox/files/x instead.

cases.case: a srcset with two root-relative candidates
warnings: index.html loads /a.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write a.png instead.
index.html loads /b.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write b.png instead.

cases.case: a root-relative url() in a style element on the page
warnings: index.html loads /bg.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write bg.png instead.

cases.case: a root-relative url() in a style attribute
warnings: index.html loads /bg.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write bg.png instead.

cases.case: a stylesheet the page loads names /bg.png in url()
warnings: styles.css loads /bg.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write bg.png instead.

cases.case: a stylesheet in a folder names /bg.png, so the fix goes up one level from the stylesheet
warnings: css/site.css loads /bg.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write ../bg.png instead.

cases.case: a stylesheet that imports /theme.css
warnings: styles.css loads /theme.css, which leaves the app's path address. Write theme.css instead.

cases.case: a root-relative stylesheet link names the page's own stylesheet
warnings: index.html loads /styles.css, which leaves the app's path address. Write styles.css instead.
styles.css loads /bg.png, which leaves the app's path address. Write bg.png instead.

cases.case: a stylesheet no page loads is not read
a public html file is a page served at the root
warnings: public/robots.html links to /about, which leaves the app's path address. Write about instead.

cases.case: a protocol-relative URL is not root-relative
the SDK file the build supplies is exempt
a file under /runtime.js/ is not the SDK and is warned about
warnings: index.html loads /runtime.js/extra.js, which leaves the app's path address. Write runtime.js/extra.js instead.

cases.case: relative and fragment URLs are fine
a root-relative URL inside an HTML comment is not read
a URL inside a script body is not read
